title: Smoky Tempeh, White Bean, and Kale Soup
intro: Crumbled tempeh acts as a hearty, savory stand-in for traditional ground sausage in this fast, one-pot soup. It delivers plant-based protein without the saturated fat found in cured meats.

ingredients.name: Low-sodium vegetable broth
ingredients.canonical_name: Soup, vegetable broth, ready to serve, low sodium

ingredients.name: No-salt-added canned diced tomatoes
ingredients.canonical_name: Tomatoes, red, ripe, canned, diced, no salt added

ingredients.name: No-salt-added canned cannellini beans
ingredients.canonical_name: Beans, white, mature seeds, canned, without salt

instructions: Warm extra-virgin olive oil in a medium pot over medium-high heat.
Add crumbled tempeh and sauté for 4 to 5 minutes until lightly browned.
Stir in smoked paprika and garlic powder, cooking for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Pour in vegetable broth, diced tomatoes, and cannellini beans, and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, stir in chopped kale, and cover the pot.
Simmer for 5 to 7 minutes, checking at 5 minutes to ensure the kale is tender.
Remove from heat, stir in red wine vinegar and salt, and ladle the soup into bowls.
variation: Swap the chopped fresh kale for fresh baby spinach.
conservation: Keeps 3 days refrigerated; reheat gently on the stovetop.
